text: Databases are organised systems for storing and managing information. Traditional SQL databases keep data in tables with rows and columns, and you use queries to search and change that data. NoSQL databases, on the other hand, are more flexible and suit changing or unstructured data. Good data modelling helps you plan the structure before you build it, which saves time later. Indexes make queries much faster, but they also use extra space, so you should add them carefully. Understanding these basic ideas makes it easier to choose the right database for your project.
